reason: The commit changes internal parsing behavior for existing HTML TEMPLATE elements but introduces no new entry point, API protocol, initialization requirement, configuration, or input constraint. The existing harnesses already send arbitrary HTML through tidyParseBuffer, tidyParseString, and tidyParseFile, including full clean/repair and diagnostic paths in several targets, so they can exercise the modified ParseBlock branch without harness changes.
evidence: TY_(ParseBlock) changes an existing else branch to else if (!nodeIsTEMPLATE(element)), special-casing an already recognized tag during normal parsing.
tags.h only adds nodeIsTEMPLATE(node) as a TagIsId(node, TidyTag_TEMPLATE) predicate; it adds no public API or required setup.
tidy_fuzzer invokes tidyParseBuffer followed by tidyCleanAndRepair and tidyRunDiagnostics on fuzzer-controlled bytes.
tidy_parse_string_fuzzer and tidy_xml_fuzzer invoke tidyParseString with fuzzer-controlled markup, while tidy_parse_file_fuzzer invokes tidyParseFile.
No new configuration option, structured input format, or state prerequisite is shown in the diff.
recommended_action: Keep the existing fuzz harnesses unchanged; template-containing inputs can reach the modified parser logic through their current high-level parsing paths.
